uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap of mean paired fresh/method ratios. Paired-row bootstrap treats trial units as independent. Fixed-k seed-block bootstrap resamples seeds within k and carries all datasets sharing that seed together; neither interval estimates deployment reliability.
scope: elapsed is serial call; modeled client-plus-server excludes network; end-to-end includes recorded input/checkpoint load, materialization and equal-schema witness output. Numeric exactness is independently saved in each trial, not inferred from timing. Metadata/output auxiliary content varies by method and is disclosed in receipts.
reduction_definitions: mean relative reduction=mean(1-method/fresh); pooled reduction=1-sum(method)/sum(fresh); ratio of mean times=sum(fresh)/sum(method) differs from mean speedup.
missing_P3: Original ACS artifacts absent; no corrected P3 inference.
